popcorn_counter.mp4.author: Mariano Quintero (Pexels)
popcorn_counter.mp4.description: Inside a lit popcorn machine at a concession stand: a hand with a green scoop digs into a warm, golden heap of fresh popcorn; red/white striped paper popcorn bags stand in the background with green and blue bokeh. Warm, shallow depth of field. No three-size tub lineup. Bags carry a partial stylised 'Popcorn' word only, no brand.

popcorn_closeup.mp4.author: Tima Miroshnichenko (Pexels)
popcorn_closeup.mp4.description: Vertical close-up in a dark cinema: a full red/yellow striped popcorn box (generic 'POPCORN' print) in the lower third, hands reaching in and taking popcorn, red seats and projector glow blurred behind. Moody and cinematic; the box is full, not overflowing.

cinema_people.mp4.author: cottonbro studio (Pexels)
cinema_people.mp4.description: Two young East/Southeast Asian women at a round table in a cinema lobby/lounge, laughing and eating popcorn from two large red-and-white striped buckets (generic 'POPCORN' roundel), 3D glasses on the table, warm golden fairy-light bokeh behind. Not South Asian, and not inside the auditorium.

magazine.mp4.author: Esra Afşar (Pexels)
magazine.mp4.description: Vertical: a man in an olive fleece reading and turning the pages of a printed Danish newspaper at a table, soft daylight. Hands turn a full-page ad. Caveat: small ad text and .dk URLs are legible at full res, plus a partial jacket logo ('Co...') on his chest. Crop tight on the hands and pages, or soften the text, if that matters.

laptop_reading.mp4.author: Mikhail Nilov (Pexels)
laptop_reading.mp4.description: Vertical: a young East Asian woman sits by a window ledge in a cosy cafe (warm wood shelves, plants, bulb light) and reads intently on a silver tablet, scrolling with one hand. The screen faces away. The tablet back shows only the camera, with no visible logo. A tablet, not a laptop.
